The '''manager''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[HZ109|Tinkatuff's Hammer Wasn't Made in a Year!]]''. She appears to be an executive linked to [[Exceed]] and by extension to the [[Explorers]], responsible for scheduling and arranging appointments and public appearances for [[Sidian]] and [[Coral]].

{{-}}
==History==
She was first seen in ''[[HZ109|Tinkatuff's Hammer Wasn't Made in a Year!]]'' when [[Sidian]] was approached by a crowd of his fans in front of a Japanese food restaurant; some time later, the manager was seen again removing [[Coral]] from the same conditions when she was seen by another group in a bakery.

With Vigoroth's help, she took the two [[Explorers]] to a {{tc|Cabbie}}, where she introduced herself and said she was responsible for scheduling their appointments. Upon arriving, she also asked the Cabbie to drive to a location in [[Paldea]]. When Coral refused, she threw them both into a [[Flying Taxi]] and forced the Cabbie to continue on his way.
